en: Isaiah 9

p.src: 1  But there shall be no more gloom for her who was in anguish. In the former time, he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time he has made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.

ja: 闇はない。以前には、ゼブルンの
en: But there shall be no more gloom for her who was in anguish. In the former time, he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time he has made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.
u.src: 1  But there shall be no more gloom for her who was in anguish. In the former time, he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time he has made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.

p.src: 2  The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. The light has shined on those who lived in the land of the shadow of death.

en: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. The light has shined on those who lived in the land of the shadow of death.
u.src: 2  The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. The light has shined on those who lived in the land of the shadow of death.

p.src: 3  You have multiplied the nation. You have increased their joy. They rejoice before you according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the plunder.

ja: ぶように、 分捕り物を分ける時に人々が喜ぶように、 あなたの
en: You have multiplied the nation. You have increased their joy. They rejoice before you according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the plunder.
u.src: 3  You have multiplied the nation. You have increased their joy. They rejoice before you according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the plunder.

p.src: 4  For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as in the day of Midian.

ja: のむちを、 ミディアンの
en: For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as in the day of Midian.
u.src: 4  For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as in the day of Midian.

p.src: 5  For all the armor of the armed man in the noisy battle, and the garments rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for the fire.

ja: いに臨む兵士のすべての
en: For all the armor of the armed man in the noisy battle, and the garments rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for the fire.
u.src: 5  For all the armor of the armed man in the noisy battle, and the garments rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for the fire.

p.src: 6  For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

ja: 一人の子どもがわれわれのために
en: For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
u.src: 6  For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

p.src: 7  Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from that time on, even forever. The zeal of the LORD of Armies will perform this.

ja: わり、 終わることがない。
を治め、 今から永遠に、
によって王国を確立し、支える。
en: Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from that time on, even forever. The zeal of the LORD of Armies will perform this.
u.src: 7  Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from that time on, even forever. The zeal of the LORD of Armies will perform this.

p.src: 8  The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it falls on Israel.

ja: られ、 それはイスラエルに降りかかった。
en: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it falls on Israel.
u.src: 8  The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it falls on Israel.

p.src: 9  All the people will know, including Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria, who say in pride and in arrogance of heart,

ja: はそれを知る。 エフライムとサマリアの
en: All the people will know, including Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria, who say in pride and in arrogance of heart,
u.src: 9  All the people will know, including Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria, who say in pride and in arrogance of heart,

p.src: 10  “The bricks have fallen, but we will build with cut stone. The sycamore fig trees have been cut down, but we will put cedars in their place.”

ja: れ落ちたが、 われわれは
されたが、 その代わりに
en: “The bricks have fallen, but we will build with cut stone. The sycamore fig trees have been cut down, but we will put cedars in their place.”
u.src: 10  “The bricks have fallen, but we will build with cut stone. The sycamore fig trees have been cut down, but we will put cedars in their place.”

p.src: 11  Therefore the LORD will set up on high against him the adversaries of Rezin, and will stir up his enemies,

ja: 対者たちを、 イスラエルに
en: Therefore the LORD will set up on high against him the adversaries of Rezin, and will stir up his enemies,
u.src: 11  Therefore the LORD will set up on high against him the adversaries of Rezin, and will stir up his enemies,

p.src: 12  The Syrians in front, and the Philistines behind; and they will devour Israel with open mouth. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

ja: りは去らず、 その御
en: The Syrians in front, and the Philistines behind; and they will devour Israel with open mouth. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
u.src: 12  The Syrians in front, and the Philistines behind; and they will devour Israel with open mouth. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

p.src: 13  Yet the people have not turned to him who struck them, neither have they sought the LORD of Armies.

en: Yet the people have not turned to him who struck them, neither have they sought the LORD of Armies.
u.src: 13  Yet the people have not turned to him who struck them, neither have they sought the LORD of Armies.

p.src: 14  Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, palm branch and reed, in one day.

ja: のうちに、 イスラエルから
en: Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, palm branch and reed, in one day.
u.src: 14  Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, palm branch and reed, in one day.

p.src: 15  The elder and the honorable man is the head, and the prophet who teaches lies is the tail.

en: The elder and the honorable man is the head, and the prophet who teaches lies is the tail.
u.src: 15  The elder and the honorable man is the head, and the prophet who teaches lies is the tail.

p.src: 16  For those who lead this people lead them astray; and those who are led by them are destroyed.

en: For those who lead this people lead them astray; and those who are led by them are destroyed.
u.src: 16  For those who lead this people lead them astray; and those who are led by them are destroyed.

p.src: 17  Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men, neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and widows; for everyone is profane and an evildoer, and every mouth speaks folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

ja: ばず、 父のない子や、やもめをあわれまない。 すべての
るからだ。 それでも
en: Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men, neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and widows; for everyone is profane and an evildoer, and every mouth speaks folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
u.src: 17  Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men, neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and widows; for everyone is profane and an evildoer, and every mouth speaks folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

p.src: 18  For wickedness burns like a fire. It devours the briers and thorns; yes, it kindles in the thickets of the forest, and they roll upward in a column of smoke.

ja: え、 いばらと茨を食い
en: For wickedness burns like a fire. It devours the briers and thorns; yes, it kindles in the thickets of the forest, and they roll upward in a column of smoke.
u.src: 18  For wickedness burns like a fire. It devours the briers and thorns; yes, it kindles in the thickets of the forest, and they roll upward in a column of smoke.

p.src: 19  Through the LORD of Armies’ wrath, the land is burned up; and the people are the fuel for the fire. No one spares his brother.

en: Through the LORD of Armies’ wrath, the land is burned up; and the people are the fuel for the fire. No one spares his brother.
u.src: 19  Through the LORD of Armies’ wrath, the land is burned up; and the people are the fuel for the fire. No one spares his brother.

p.src: 20  One will devour on the right hand, and be hungry; and he will eat on the left hand, and they will not be satisfied. Everyone will eat the flesh of his own arm:

ja: 側のものを食い尽くしても
たされない。 だれもが
en: One will devour on the right hand, and be hungry; and he will eat on the left hand, and they will not be satisfied. Everyone will eat the flesh of his own arm:
u.src: 20  One will devour on the right hand, and be hungry; and he will eat on the left hand, and they will not be satisfied. Everyone will eat the flesh of his own arm:

p.src: 21  Manasseh eating Ephraim and Ephraim eating Manasseh, and they together will be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

ja: マナセはエフライムを
べ、 エフライムはマナセを
en: Manasseh eating Ephraim and Ephraim eating Manasseh, and they together will be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
u.src: 21  Manasseh eating Ephraim and Ephraim eating Manasseh, and they together will be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
